description:
How much this corpus holds and how fresh it is: total domains, certificates and log entries seen in the last 24 hours, DNS resolution coverage, CT log health, and the leading issuers and TLDs.

Use this to calibrate a claim about coverage before making one — in particular, "domains_no_dns" is the count of domains for which no address has ever been resolved, and it is a large fraction of the corpus. Most of what certificate transparency shows has never resolved.

as_of is when the figures were computed, which may be up to about ten minutes ago; the figures move by fractions of a percent over that interval.

Free, no key, no arguments, and cheap: the figures are precomputed, so repeat calls return the same as_of until the next refresh. top_issuers and top_tlds are the ten largest. For one domain use lookup_domain; for what is being issued right now use recent_certificates.
name: corpus_stats
title: Corpus size and coverage
